title: Fluid headings with one clamp()
why_it_matters: Headings that scale smoothly mean fewer breakpoints to maintain.
explanation: clamp takes a minimum, a preferred value and a maximum. The preferred value usually uses vw so it grows with the screen. The browser never goes below the minimum or above the maximum, so text stays readable on every device.
try_it: Apply clamp to your h1, then drag the browser width and watch it stop at both ends.
